searchText: I think we should call it Jan3 🤣 Meth 2? Multi-client Eth 2 test-net 🥳 lol **HAOYUatHZ** hi folks! **HAOYUatHZ** why eth2.0 is using RANDAO instead of RANDAO++(https://www.reddit.com/r/ethereum/comments/4mdkku/could_ethereum_do_this_better_tor_project_is/d3v6djb/) proposed by vitalik? The timeline is RANDAO -> RANDAO++ -> ETH2.0, isn’t it? RANDAO++ should already exist when eth2.0 design started? **HAOYUatHZ** BTW, is eth2.0 already using RANDAO+VDF? seems currently it is still using RANDAO? RANDAO++ looks like a variation to harden RANDAO against last revealed attacks using a proof-of-work. There is a variation of RANDAO where the output is put into a VDF (sequential proof of work) and depending on the progress of VDFs is planned to be used eventually in eth2 these types of protocols rely on assumptions in attacker speed in the sequential proof of work, and thus make the problem hard **HAOYUatHZ** thx! **HAOYUatHZ** will it be difficult to adding VDF in the future? **HAOYUatHZ** if the beacon chain is already running, would adding VDF require a soft(?) fork? **dankrad** Yes it requires a fork. But several forks of the beacon chain will be required either way **HAOYUatHZ** got it. Thx! is there any concrete date on when the official multi client test net will be bootstrapped?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
RANDAO++ looks like a variation to harden RANDAO against last revealed attacks using a proof-of-work. 
There is a variation of RANDAO where the output is put into a VDF (sequential proof of work) and depending on the progress of VDFs is planned to be used eventually in eth2
